name: Ghushine Fintrrade Ocean Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Ghushine Fintrrade Ocean Ltd operates in the textile and diamond business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GFOL principal products consist of textiles and diamond-related items that are mainly sold in the domestic market. It is a supplier of 100% 
organic fabrics by offering a wide range of curtains, unstitched dress materials, sofa fabrics, grey fabrics, and sarees.
